problem: Developers need one place to run many coding agents in parallel with isolated worktrees, review and PRs.
business_model: Open source desktop app, monetization not stated

founders.name: Raban von Spiegel
founders.background_notes: Research on software performance engineering at MIT CSAIL per YC page.

founders.name: Arne Strickmann
founders.background_notes: YC page names only Arne; surname from a search summary.

competitors.name: Conductor
competitors.what: macOS app running Claude Code and Codex in parallel worktrees

competitors.name: Crystal
competitors.what: MIT app running agents in parallel worktrees, now Nimbalyst

technical_complexity.rationale: A desktop app orchestrating CLI agents in git worktrees is moderate engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Open source and copyable, and Claude Code added built-in worktrees.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Agent vendors shipped their own desktop and worktree features; Claude Code has built in worktree support per a roundup.

market_need_then: Parallel coding agents became common in 2025 and 2026; the Show HN launch on 2026-02-24 drew discussion (points differ by mirror).

branding.domain_note: Company uses emdash.com and emdash.sh; acquisition history not found

brand_strength.rationale: Memorable name tied to a punctuation mark that became a hot AI-writing topic; no source confirms the origin. A trademark application for EMDASH (April 2026, General Action Inc) is pending.

outcome_analysis: Emdash is a Winter 2026 company with no outcome yet. It launched open source with a Show HN in February 2026 and supports 20 plus agent CLIs, which fits product led growth among developers. Defensibility is weak because it is open source and agent vendors ship similar worktree features, so monetization and staying neutral across agents are the open questions.
notes: Funding conflicts: VCBacked 500K pre-seed, Dealroom and PitchBook 125K with YC and Zero Prime Ventures; all aggregators, unverified, no round recorded. License reported as MIT in one source and Apache-2.0 in another. Website fetch blocked by a rate limited safety check.
